identification: Two Tasmanian studio pottery vases. Left: unglazed (bisque) vase with incised signature 'John Campbell Tasmania' and number 15 on the base (John Campbell Pottery, Tasmania, 1930s). Right: small drip-glazed brown/red vase, base incised with a number (17?) and mark, with a chip/glaze loss on the rim (sold 'as is'); likely also Campbell but the mark is not clearly legible.
